records.verificationNote: Preferred: aripiprazole tabs (PDF p.56, Tier 1, no flag); alternatives read from PDF pp.56-60. Aripiprazole 10 mg is the printed strength chosen as the reference tablet (printed tablet strengths 2-30 mg). Named drugs present with Tier 1 and no flag: aripiprazole, clozapine, lurasidone, olanzapine, paliperidone ER, quetiapine IR and ER, risperidone tabs/soln, ziprasidone caps. Not printed: cariprazine (Vraylar), brexpiprazole (Rexulti), lumateperone (Caplyta), asenapine (Saphris), iloperidone (Fanapt), olanzapine/samidorphan (Lybalvi); treated as unconfirmed. Document says: "Kaiser Foundation Health Plan does not have a requirement for PA" (PDF p.6) and "does not have a requirement for Step Therapy" (PDF p.7). Drugs not listed are nonformulary; when a Kaiser or referral doctor determines one is medically appropriate and necessary it is covered by formulary exception (PDF p.7; decision within 72 hours, 24 urgent, PDF p.8). Completeness is ambiguous: p.6 defines the formulary as "the complete list of prescription drugs preferred for use and eligible for coverage" but p.2 says "not an all-inclusive list", so absence is not treated as exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: pick, tier and flags re-read in the document; 6 named absent drug(s) added as nonformulary (exception route)]
